asset: verdicts B3: Q1 the rest, the first fights' attacks and deaths in 8 facings
status: for the art director's read. Not imported

attacks_plain.tool: animate_object v3, frame_count 6, keep_first_frame false, one call per creature for its side and diagonal facings, one for N
attacks_plain.words: brief 11's per creature + "then returns to its stance, feet planted, nothing else appears in the frame"; N: "lunges/swoops/darts/thrusts away from the viewer ... reach up and forward 2-3 px, then back ..."; the fliers' S: "swoops/darts toward the viewer ... reach down and forward 2-3 px ..."; the slime's 8: B3's slime words + "the same face throughout, two open dot eyes, no mouth, the bottom stays on the ground"
attacks_plain.made: rat W SE SW NE NW; spider W SE SW NE NW N; bat E W SE SW NE NW S N; wasp W SE SW NE NW S N; kobold W SE SW NE NW N; rat_king E W SE SW NE NW N; slime all 8

attacks_pose_route_S: every S attack of a body on legs (cistern_spider, kobold_tosher, rat_king): edit_image_pro_flash on the S still to the blow ("... thrust down and forward toward the viewer by three pixels ...", 5 gens) then animate_image still -> pose, frame_count 4 (frame_004 = the blow). Laid 0 1 2 4 2 1 as the rat's
deaths_plain: slime e n se ne ("melts flat into a puddle ..."); bat e n se ne and wasp s e n se ne ("stops flapping, falls to the floor on its back, wings spread, and lies still, eyes closed ..."); kobold e n w se sw ne nw ("falls flat on its back, the spear beside it ..."); rat_king e n w se sw ne nw ("collapses and falls face down, his cape spread, the bone sceptre beside him ...")

deaths_pose_route.by the brief (roll over): rat n se ne, cistern_spider e n se ne
deaths_pose_route.refused plain rolls (stood or rose; read: culvert_bat ne, hive_wasp e n ne se, slime e n ne se (all four rose into a bell, as S did), rat_king ne nw
deaths_pose_route.kept plain: bat e n se, wasp s, kobold all 7, rat_king e n w se sw
deaths_pose_route.how: edit_image_pro_flash on the facing's still to the corpse (5 gens, eyes closed), animate_image still -> pose, frame_count 6 (frame_006 = the corpse)

layout: <creature>/<facing>.png the rotation; <creature>/attack|attackpose|death|deathpose/<facing>/frame_NNN.png; pose-<facing>.png the edit; death-seated/ and deathpose-seated/ = every death re-seated (the corpse's lowest row on the still's foot row, 43 for the bat and wasp, whole-frame steps, never lifted); analysis.json = per attack the changed pixels per frame and the lay with the most-changed frame on index 3, per death the fall test and the seat shift
flags: slime attack N: the back view grows a face (dot eyes and a smile, frames 2-6); NW shows a faint face; S shuts its eyes at frame 1: 'the same face throughout' held only on the side facings
slime death poses N and E: a small drip spike rises on top at frames 2-4; SE: the melt passes through a hollow arch shape at frames 4-5
the lay uses the frame that differs most from the still as the blow (a reach measure on the facing proved unreliable: tails and wings set the extremes); check index 3 by eye
bat death SE kept plain: it lies tilted on its side, not flat on its back
rat death N pose: a curled ball seen from behind; the top barely drops (top-down roll-overs read by shape, not height)
every pose-route death re-seated by 1-10 px (the edits float their corpses)
review_strips: art/review/gen-2026-11-09b/b3-<creature>.png, one per creature (x2, 64 cells, frames as is): each row the still then the frames; plain attacks unbarred, pose-route rows amber-barred, plain deaths grey-barred (the seated copy shown)
